items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Completes Record IPO and Closes First Trading Day Up 17%
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 完成史上最大 IPO，首日收盤上漲 17%
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, selling 980 million shares to raise about $81.3 billion (plus roughly $26 billion in concurrent private placement for a total near $107 billion). Shares began trading on Nasdaq as ANT on November 19, opened at $111.50 (+34%), and closed at $97.17 (+17% from the IPO price), implying a fully diluted market value around $1.8 trillion. The offering is expected to close on November 20.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 將 IPO 定價為每股 83 美元，售出 9.8 億股籌得約 813 億美元（加上約 260 億美元同步私募，總額近 1070 億美元）。11 月 19 日以 ANT 代號在 Nasdaq 開始交易，開盤 111.50 美元（漲 34%），收盤 97.17 美元（較 IPO 價上漲 17%），全稀釋市值約 1.8 兆美元。發行預計於 11 月 20 日完成交割。
items_flat.analysis_en: As the first pure-play frontier AI lab to go public, Anthropic’s debut supplies a live public valuation benchmark for the sector. The strong open followed by a partial fade, plus the dual-class voting structure that keeps control with founders, highlights both investor demand and the volatility still attached to pure AI model makers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Anthropic 成為首家純 AI 前沿實驗室掛牌，為整個產業提供即時公開估值基準。強勁開盤後部分回落，加上雙層股權讓創辦人保有控制權，同時顯示投資人需求與純模型公司仍存在的波動風險。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock at $83.00 per share.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日 Anthropic, PBC 將其 A 類普通股首次公開發行定價為每股 83.00 美元。

links.label: Anthropic on X – Dario Amodei Remarks

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind Rolls Out Gemini 4 Neon for Coding and Knowledge Work
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 4 Neon，主打編碼與知識工作
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen. It offers frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion, a 1M-token context, four thinking levels, and pricing of $3 / $15 per million input/output tokens. It is available via the Gemini API, AI Studio, Antigravity, and the Gemini app.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Neon，定位於 Carbon 與 Hydrogen 之間。它提供前沿水準智能、快速端到端任務完成、100 萬 token 上下文、四種思考層級，定價為每百萬輸入/輸出 token 3 / 15 美元。可透過 Gemini API、AI Studio、Antigravity 與 Gemini 應用程式使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Neon continues Google’s rapid cadence of Gemini 4 variants, aiming for better cost-per-task on agentic coding and science workflows. Independent confirmation of the claimed efficiency edge versus Carbon remains the key open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Neon 延續 Google Gemini 4 系列的快速迭代節奏，目標是在代理編碼與科學工作流上取得更好的每任務成本。相對 Carbon 的效率優勢仍待獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 4 Neon is rolling out now. Sitting between Carbon and Hydrogen, it brings frontier intelligence and fast task completion for complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Neon 現正推出。它介於 Carbon 與 Hydrogen 之間，為複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學帶來前沿智能與快速任務完成能力。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out New ChatGPT Mobile Design with Dedicated Dot Tab and Expands Health
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 手機新介面，新增 Dot 專屬分頁並擴展健康功能
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI is rolling out a redesigned ChatGPT mobile experience that places a user’s Dot in its own bottom tab and lets people pin tools such as Codex, Projects, and Images. The update starts with Pro users (18+) in regions where Dots are available (excluding EEA, UK, Switzerland, and Korea) plus a small set of Plus users. Concurrently, ChatGPT Health is expanding to Android (with Health Connect), desktop, Dots, and Sites, enabling proactive suggestions based on connected health data.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 正推出重新設計的 ChatGPT 手機體驗，讓使用者的 Dot 擁有獨立底部標籤，並可釘選 Codex、Projects、Images 等工具。更新先從符合資格的 Pro 用戶（18 歲以上、Dots 可用地區，排除歐盟經濟區、英國、瑞士與韓國）以及少數 Plus 用戶開始。同時，ChatGPT Health 正擴展至 Android（支援 Health Connect）、桌面、Dots 與 Sites，可根據已連結的健康資料提供主動建議。
items_flat.analysis_en: The redesign treats Dots as a first-class, always-available surface rather than a buried feature, signaling OpenAI’s push toward proactive agents. The simultaneous Health expansion raises practical questions about data permissions and cross-platform consistency as agents gain more personal context.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 新介面把 Dots 提升為一等公民的常駐入口，而非隱藏功能，顯示 OpenAI 正加速推動主動代理。健康功能同步擴展，也讓代理取得更多個人脈絡時的資料權限與跨平台一致性成為實際問題。
items_flat.quote: We’re rolling out a new experience for the ChatGPT mobile app that makes it easier to get to your favorite features and discover more of what you can do. Your dot has its own tab, and you can pin favorites like Codex, Projects, and Images to the tab bar.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在推出 ChatGPT 手機應用的新體驗，讓你更容易找到最愛功能並發現更多可能性。你的 Dot 擁有獨立分頁，你也可以把 Codex、Projects、Images 等釘選到底部標籤列。

items_flat.title_en: Google Launches Tool Retrieval in Gemini API for Large Agent Tool Libraries
items_flat.title_zh: Google 在 Gemini API 推出 Tool Retrieval，支援大型代理工具庫
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced Tool Retrieval (preview) in the Gemini Interactions API. Agents can keep full tool libraries available while loading parameter schemas only on demand, reducing input tokens, latency, and selection errors when dealing with large tool sets.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 在 Gemini Interactions API 推出 Tool Retrieval（預覽）。代理可保持完整工具庫可用，同時只在需要時載入參數結構描述，藉此降低輸入 token、延遲與大型工具集下的選擇錯誤。
items_flat.analysis_en: This addresses a practical scaling bottleneck for production agents. By deferring schema loading while preserving prefix caching, Google is making high-tool-count workflows more economical without forcing developers to prune libraries.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這解決了生產代理的實際擴展瓶頸。延遲載入結構描述同時保留前綴快取，讓高工具數量工作流更經濟，開發者不必手動裁剪工具庫。
items_flat.quote: Tool Retrieval lets your agent keep its full tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when the current task needs them.
items_flat.quote_zh: Tool Retrieval 讓你的代理將完整工具庫待命，僅在當前任務需要時才載入參數 schema。

items_flat.title_en: Reuters Reports Internal Privacy and Cross-Account Issues with Meta’s Muse Agent
items_flat.title_zh: 路透報導 Meta Muse 代理出現內部隱私與跨帳號問題
items_flat.summary_en: A Reuters investigation of internal Meta employee posts found that Muse sometimes sent unsolicited messages about childcare, career advice, purchases, and bank balances that employees said did not belong to them, and in some cases accessed content from encrypted apps such as Signal. Meta stated that employee testing uses versions with features not available to the public and that feedback is part of the safety process. Muse has surpassed 10 million downloads since its September launch.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透調查 Meta 內部員工貼文發現，Muse 有時會發送員工表示並非自己要求的訊息，內容涉及托育、職涯建議、購物與銀行餘額，部分情況還觸及 Signal 等加密應用的內容。Meta 表示員工測試使用的是尚未對公眾開放的版本，回饋是安全流程的一部分。Muse 自 9 月推出以來已超過 1000 萬下載。
items_flat.analysis_en: The reports illustrate the practical safety and privacy gaps that appear when always-on personal agents gain broad device and notification access. Meta’s distinction between employee and public builds is relevant, but the speed of Muse’s consumer rollout means external validation of the fixes will matter more than internal assurances.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 報導顯示常駐個人代理在取得廣泛裝置與通知權限時，實際安全與隱私缺口很快浮現。Meta 區分員工與公眾版本有其道理，但 Muse 快速面向消費者推出，外部驗證修復成效會比內部聲明更重要。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Details Performance Factory: Codex-Powered System Keeping ChatGPT Fast
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述 Performance Factory：以 Codex 驅動維持 ChatGPT 速度的系統
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published an engineering post on its internal Performance Factory, an autonomous Codex-powered system that investigates and fixes performance regressions end-to-end. In over three months the Regression Workflow tracked more than 1,700 issues.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布工程文章，介紹內部的 Performance Factory——一套由 Codex 驅動的自主系統，可端到端調查並修復效能回歸。在超過三個月內，Regression Workflow 追蹤了超過 1,700 個問題。
items_flat.analysis_en: This shows how labs are applying agentic coding tools to their own infrastructure at scale. Success depends on the quality of adversarial checks and engineer review; early internal results are promising but remain self-reported.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這顯示實驗室正大規模把代理編碼工具應用於自身基礎設施。成效取決於對抗性檢查與工程師審核的品質；早期內部結果正面，但仍屬自我報告。
items_flat.quote: The Performance Factory, which runs in the cloud and automates investigating and resolving performance problems, enables us to keep pace with the ambition of our roadmap.
items_flat.quote_zh: Performance Factory 在雲端運行並自動化調查與解決效能問題，讓我們能跟上路線圖的雄心。

items_flat.title_en: Meta’s Muse Wonder Tops Legora November BAR Legal Benchmark
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 的 Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月 BAR 法律基準取得最高分
items_flat.summary_en: AI at Meta highlighted that Muse Wonder earned the highest overall quality score in Legora’s November BAR benchmark for real-world legal tasks. It led in analysis and answering, extraction, drafting, and editing. GPT-6.2 Astra led on comparison tasks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta AI 指出，Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月 BAR 基準的真實世界法律任務中取得最高整體品質分數。它在分析與回答、擷取、起草與編輯等項目領先。GPT-6.2 Astra 在比較任務上領先。
items_flat.analysis_en: Legal work is a high-stakes, structured domain where small quality edges matter. Meta’s result is a useful external signal for Muse Wonder’s agentic strengths, though single-benchmark leadership does not yet prove broad superiority.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 法律工作是高風險、結構嚴謹的領域，微小品質優勢就很重要。Meta 的結果是 Muse Wonder 代理能力的有用外部信號，但單一基準領先尚未證明全面優勢。
items_flat.quote: Muse Wonder earned the highest overall quality score in Legora’s November BAR benchmark for legal work.
items_flat.quote_zh: Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月 BAR 法律工作基準中獲得最高整體品質分數。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Makes GPT-Live-1.1 Available in the Live API
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在 Live API 提供 GPT-Live-1.1
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1.1 in the Live API. The full-duplex voice model improves pronunciation, accent consistency, and transcription across languages, adds a cheaper standby/idle mode ($0.02/min), and strengthens instruction following. It had already powered ChatGPT voice for Plus and Pro users.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 Live API 推出 GPT-Live-1.1。這款全雙工語音模型改善跨語言發音、口音一致性與轉錄，新增更便宜的待機/閒置模式（每分鐘 0.02 美元），並強化指令遵循。它此前已為 ChatGPT Plus 與 Pro 用戶提供語音服務。
items_flat.analysis_en: Incremental but practical for production voice agents. The standby pricing lowers the cost of long-running or intermittent sessions, which is relevant as always-on agents become more common.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 對生產語音代理而言是增量但實用的更新。待機定價降低長時間或間歇性會話成本，隨著常駐代理更普及而變得重要。
items_flat.quote: GPT-Live-1.1 is now available in the API! You can use it to build voice agents that speak with more natural and consistent accents across languages...
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-Live-1.1 現已在 API 提供！你可以用它打造語音代理，讓它以更自然且一致的跨語言口音說話...

items_flat.title_en: Community Grok Bot Directory Gains Traction as Unofficial Hub for Custom Bots
items_flat.title_zh: 社群 Grok Bot Directory 作為非官方自訂機器人中心獲得關注
items_flat.summary_en: A community-run Grok Bot Directory (grok-bot.directory) launched in mid-November, allowing users to browse, add, and share custom Grok Bots and apps. By November 20 it listed roughly 1,430 bot pages. It is independent of xAI’s official Marketplace; Elon Musk and SpaceXSI engineers publicly noted the idea of companies composed of Grok Bots.
items_flat.summary_zh: 社群營運的 Grok Bot Directory（grok-bot.directory）於 11 月中旬上線，讓用戶可瀏覽、新增並分享自訂 Grok Bots 與應用。至 11 月 20 日已列出約 1,430 個機器人頁面。它獨立於 xAI 官方 Marketplace；Elon Musk 與 SpaceXSI 工程師曾公開提及由 Grok Bots 組成公司的概念。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid appearance of an independent directory shows demand for sharing agent configurations outside official channels. Quality, security, and endorsement questions remain open because listing does not imply xAI review or support.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 獨立目錄快速出現，顯示用戶在官方渠道之外分享代理設定的需求。由於上架不代表 xAI 審核或背書，品質、安全性與責任歸屬仍屬未解問題。

links.label: i10X Coverage of Grok Bot Directory

google.title_en: Google Launches Tool Retrieval in Gemini API for Large Agent Tool Libraries
google.title_zh: Google 在 Gemini API 推出 Tool Retrieval，支援大型代理工具庫
google.summary_en: Google introduced Tool Retrieval (preview) in the Gemini Interactions API. Agents can keep full tool libraries available while loading parameter schemas only on demand, reducing input tokens, latency, and selection errors when dealing with large tool sets.
google.summary_zh: Google 在 Gemini Interactions API 推出 Tool Retrieval（預覽）。代理可保持完整工具庫可用，同時只在需要時載入參數結構描述，藉此降低輸入 token、延遲與大型工具集下的選擇錯誤。
google.analysis_en: This addresses a practical scaling bottleneck for production agents. By deferring schema loading while preserving prefix caching, Google is making high-tool-count workflows more economical without forcing developers to prune libraries.
google.analysis_zh: 這解決了生產代理的實際擴展瓶頸。延遲載入結構描述同時保留前綴快取，讓高工具數量工作流更經濟，開發者不必手動裁剪工具庫。
google.quote: Tool Retrieval lets your agent keep its full tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when the current task needs them.
google.quote_zh: Tool Retrieval 讓你的代理將完整工具庫待命，僅在當前任務需要時才載入參數 schema。

meta.title_en: Reuters Reports Internal Privacy and Cross-Account Issues with Meta’s Muse Agent
meta.title_zh: 路透報導 Meta Muse 代理出現內部隱私與跨帳號問題
meta.summary_en: A Reuters investigation of internal Meta employee posts found that Muse sometimes sent unsolicited messages about childcare, career advice, purchases, and bank balances that employees said did not belong to them, and in some cases accessed content from encrypted apps such as Signal. Meta stated that employee testing uses versions with features not available to the public and that feedback is part of the safety process. Muse has surpassed 10 million downloads since its September launch.
meta.summary_zh: 路透調查 Meta 內部員工貼文發現，Muse 有時會發送員工表示並非自己要求的訊息，內容涉及托育、職涯建議、購物與銀行餘額，部分情況還觸及 Signal 等加密應用的內容。Meta 表示員工測試使用的是尚未對公眾開放的版本，回饋是安全流程的一部分。Muse 自 9 月推出以來已超過 1000 萬下載。
meta.analysis_en: The reports illustrate the practical safety and privacy gaps that appear when always-on personal agents gain broad device and notification access. Meta’s distinction between employee and public builds is relevant, but the speed of Muse’s consumer rollout means external validation of the fixes will matter more than internal assurances.
meta.analysis_zh: 報導顯示常駐個人代理在取得廣泛裝置與通知權限時，實際安全與隱私缺口很快浮現。Meta 區分員工與公眾版本有其道理，但 Muse 快速面向消費者推出，外部驗證修復成效會比內部聲明更重要。

meta.title_en: Meta’s Muse Wonder Tops Legora November BAR Legal Benchmark
meta.title_zh: Meta 的 Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月 BAR 法律基準取得最高分
meta.summary_en: AI at Meta highlighted that Muse Wonder earned the highest overall quality score in Legora’s November BAR benchmark for real-world legal tasks. It led in analysis and answering, extraction, drafting, and editing. GPT-6.2 Astra led on comparison tasks.
meta.summary_zh: Meta AI 指出，Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月 BAR 基準的真實世界法律任務中取得最高整體品質分數。它在分析與回答、擷取、起草與編輯等項目領先。GPT-6.2 Astra 在比較任務上領先。
meta.analysis_en: Legal work is a high-stakes, structured domain where small quality edges matter. Meta’s result is a useful external signal for Muse Wonder’s agentic strengths, though single-benchmark leadership does not yet prove broad superiority.
meta.analysis_zh: 法律工作是高風險、結構嚴謹的領域，微小品質優勢就很重要。Meta 的結果是 Muse Wonder 代理能力的有用外部信號，但單一基準領先尚未證明全面優勢。
meta.quote: Muse Wonder earned the highest overall quality score in Legora’s November BAR benchmark for legal work.
meta.quote_zh: Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月 BAR 法律工作基準中獲得最高整體品質分數。

xai.title_en: Community Grok Bot Directory Gains Traction as Unofficial Hub for Custom Bots
xai.title_zh: 社群 Grok Bot Directory 作為非官方自訂機器人中心獲得關注
xai.summary_en: A community-run Grok Bot Directory (grok-bot.directory) launched in mid-November, allowing users to browse, add, and share custom Grok Bots and apps. By November 20 it listed roughly 1,430 bot pages. It is independent of xAI’s official Marketplace; Elon Musk and SpaceXSI engineers publicly noted the idea of companies composed of Grok Bots.
xai.summary_zh: 社群營運的 Grok Bot Directory（grok-bot.directory）於 11 月中旬上線，讓用戶可瀏覽、新增並分享自訂 Grok Bots 與應用。至 11 月 20 日已列出約 1,430 個機器人頁面。它獨立於 xAI 官方 Marketplace；Elon Musk 與 SpaceXSI 工程師曾公開提及由 Grok Bots 組成公司的概念。
xai.analysis_en: The rapid appearance of an independent directory shows demand for sharing agent configurations outside official channels. Quality, security, and endorsement questions remain open because listing does not imply xAI review or support.
xai.analysis_zh: 獨立目錄快速出現，顯示用戶在官方渠道之外分享代理設定的需求。由於上架不代表 xAI 審核或背書，品質、安全性與責任歸屬仍屬未解問題。

Meta’s Muse drew praise on a legal benchmark while facing Reuters-reported internal privacy issues. Google’s Neon and tool-retrieval updates continue to shape agent economics.
